ai_positioning.summary: La société n'a pas mentionné l'intelligence artificielle, l'apprentissage automatique ou des termes similaires dans les extraits fournis de son rapport 10-K/20-F. Par conséquent, sa position sur l'IA ne peut être déterminée à partir de ces informations.

risks.title: Dependence on consumer discretionary spending
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented first in the Economic and Industry Risks section. Strong language ('materially impact', 'negatively impacted') underscores high severity. Current macroeconomic context with inflation, recession fears and trade policy uncertainty amplifies this risk. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Company performance is highly dependent on discretionary consumer spending, vulnerable to economic downturns, inflation and global economic uncertainty.

risks.title: Global supply chain disruptions and geopolitical events
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Economic and Industry Risks section covering conflicts, health crises and trade policies. Language intensity ('negatively impact', 'materially harm') and global scope justify high severity rating. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Unexpected global events including conflicts, health crises and trade policy changes can disrupt operations, increase costs and affect product availability worldwide.

risks.title: Intense competition and competitor resources
risks.score_rationale: Positioned prominently in competition section. Company faces well-resourced competitors with significant brand equity and distribution capabilities. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Intense competitive pressures from established and emerging competitors with substantial resources, requiring continuous innovation and brand differentiation.
